title: Open the global search palette with the keyboard shortcut (⌘K / Ctrl+K)
preconds: 1. Sign in to ShopView and go to any page, for example the Work Orders list. The persistent search field in the app header shows the shortcut hint (for example 'Search ⌘K').

The footer keyboard legend is visible: ↓↑ Navigate · ⏎ Select · Esc Close. This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9160 and the Global Search - Product Requirements specification version 1.5 (Confluence page 576978945), section 5.1 (trigger and surface), read on 16 September 2026. Note: earlier this case gave only 'a plain search placeholder'. Spec v1.3 (2026-09-01, §5.1) fixes the exact placeholder and that the modal is centered (not anchored to the header); this case follows the current spec. Last checked against build v26.36.7-21b4db9 on 9/16/2026. AUTOMATION: READY
